name: services/guide/page
description: Allows to get an university guide page by its id.
brief_description: Get a single university guide page.

arguments.name: lang
arguments.description: A code of the preferred language ("pl" or "en"). It may influence the order of entries on the page.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of selected fields:

  • Primary:

    • id - Id of the guide page;

    • title - Title of the guide page (you can use it eg. as a tab name);

    • entries - Entries on the page.

      This field references objects returned by entry method. See its returns section for possible subfields.

    • chapter - Chapter of the guide page. It is used to group pages on the similar topics.

      This field references objects returned by chapter method. See its returns section for possible subfields.

result_fields.name: title
result_fields.description: Title of the guide page (you can use it eg. as a tab name)

result_fields.name: chapter
result_fields.description: Chapter of the guide page. It is used to group pages on the similar topics
